44VM-a8M61mNqd6ddNEdjA.zh: 小兒麻痺症全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/18-24期間,cVDPV1 新增2國共3例,分別為寮國2例(前已掌握)、衣索比亞1例;cVDPV2新增中非共和國/馬利各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增奈及利亞1件。
44VM-a8M61mNqd6ddNEdjA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 18–24 June: cVDPV1 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in Laos (previously identified) and 1 in Ethiopia; cVDPV2 cases increased by 1 each in the Central African Republic and Mali; and for environmental samples, cVDPV2 increased by 1 in Nigeria.

L1_GqAcUQggZp6QdSZShdg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,地理擴散至第4個省份上韋萊省(Haut-Uele),一名自伊圖里省移入的病患抵達後死亡 。上韋萊省位於DRC東北部,與南蘇丹及中非共和國接壤且跨境移動頻繁,大幅提升跨國傳播風險,且當地武裝衝突嚴重,阻礙防疫工作,當局已禁止首都金夏沙及多省的大型集會。截至6/27止,DRC累計報告1,274例確定病例與360例死亡;烏干達則報告20例確定病例與2例死亡。
L1_GqAcUQggZp6QdSZShdg.en: The DRC continues to report new cases, and geographic spread has extended to a fourth province, Haut-Uélé, where a patient transferred from Ituri died after arrival. Haut-Uélé is located in the north-east of the DRC, borders South Sudan and the Central African Republic, and has frequent cross-border movement, which substantially raises the risk of transnational spread. Local armed conflict is severe and hinders disease control efforts, and authorities have banned large gatherings in the capital, Kinshasa, and several provinces. As of 27 June, the DRC has reported 1,274 confirmed cases and 360 deaths cumulatively; Uganda has reported 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths.

aZ7qJ1jpF5IHNp0X-meQ1w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/27-6/2期間,cVDPV2 新增3國共4例,分別為中非共和國2例、馬拉威/奈及利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦4件,cVDPV2新增馬拉威2 件。
aZ7qJ1jpF5IHNp0X-meQ1w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 27 May and 2 June, cVDPV2 detections were newly added in three countries, totalling four cases: two in the Central African Republic and one each in Malawi and Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added four specimens in Pakistan and cVDPV2 added two in Malawi.

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情持續擴大,疫情主要分布於DRC伊圖里與北基伍省,兩國截至5/23累計報告91例確診及10例死亡、867例疑病例及204例疑病例死亡,且匡列1,261名接觸者。DRC伊圖里省傳出3名紅十字會志工染病死亡,南基伍省(South Kivu)亦於5/20通報首例28歲死亡確診個案。烏干達迄今累積報告5例確診,其中1例死亡。另南蘇丹澄清其境內疑病例,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。 WHO指出疫情在5/15通報前恐已隱匿傳播數週或數月,導致疫情蔓延至多個省份。非洲CDC評估有10個非洲國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、南蘇丹、坦尚亞及尚比亞。 WHO緊急委員會第一次會議臨時建議,評估剛果民主共和國風險為「非常高」,烏干達及區域風險為「高」,全球風險為「低」。建議疫區國家啟動國家災害或突發事件管理機制,並執行包括加強監測等防控措施;區域層級國家應建立與地方各層級相銜接的國家協調機制制定相關措施;其他國家對來自已記錄到病毒(BDBV)感染地區出現不明原因發熱症狀的旅行者進行檢測、評估、報告及管理,執行公眾之疫情風險溝通等。
sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to expand, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu provinces of the DRC. As of 23 May, the two countries had reported 91 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, and 1,261 contacts had been listed. In Ituri Province, DRC, three Red Cross volunteers were reported to have died after infection. South Kivu Province reported its first confirmed case, a death in a 28-year-old, on 20 May. Uganda has reported five cumulative confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. South Sudan clarified that a suspected case in its territory tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases there. WHO notes that the outbreak may have spread silently for several weeks or months before it was reported on 15 May, leading to spread across multiple provinces. The Africa CDC assesses that 10 African countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The first meeting of the WHO Emergency Committee provisionally assessed the risk as very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and at regional level, and low globally. It recommends that affected countries activate national disaster or emergency management mechanisms and implement control measures, including enhanced surveillance; that countries in the region establish national coordination mechanisms linked to local levels; and that other countries test, assess, report and manage travellers with unexplained fever who have been in areas where Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection has been recorded, and communicate public health risks.

GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年2/28累計144國/地區報告18萬1千餘例確診病例,其中,至少492例死亡。 今年2月共計46國家/地區報告1,184 例新增確診病例,其中4例死亡,58.6%來自非洲地區,相較今年1月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降或持平,阿根廷、奧地利及中非共和國通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/2/1-3/15)共計17國通報907例確診病例,其中7例死亡,以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、肯亞、蒲隆地及賴比瑞亞為高;非洲以外地區,奧地利、比利時、葡萄牙、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。
GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.en: Monthly update: Since 2022 and up to 28 February this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 181,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 492 died. In February this year, 46 countries and regions reported 1,184 new confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; 58.6% came from the African Region. Compared with January this year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined or held steady. Argentina, Austria and the Central African Republic reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (1 February–15 March 2026), 17 countries reported 907 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths; the highest numbers were in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Burundi and Liberia. Outside Africa, Austria, Belgium, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to report clade Ib community transmission.

aoApAvC_qJ5UJe7J0GYTFg.zh: WHO非洲區今年截至第10週累計報告3,988例疑病例及173例死亡病例,其中日及查德共計2地區達疫情流行閾,中非共和國、日、剛果民主共和國、查德及多哥部分地區達警戒閾。疑病例中,312例經實驗室檢驗病原體,其中包含肺炎鏈球菌(42.9%)、腦膜炎雙球菌C型(38.5%)、腦膜炎雙球菌W型(10.9%)、非b型流感嗜血桿菌(1.3%)等。
aoApAvC_qJ5UJe7J0GYTFg.en: The WHO African Region reported 3,988 suspected cases and 173 deaths as of week 10 this year. Niger and Chad have reached the epidemic threshold, while parts of the Central African Republic, Niger, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Chad and Togo have reached the alert threshold. Of the suspected cases, 312 were tested in the laboratory for pathogens, including Streptococcus pneumoniae (42.9%), Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C (38.5%), Neisseria meningitidis serogroup W (10.9%), non-type b Haemophilus influenzae (1.3%) and others.

NST5qw4KSTLm8LGw8R6uiA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/22-1/28期間,WPV1新增阿富汗1例;cVDPV2新增中非共和國/查德/馬利各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦9件、阿富汗5件,cVDPV2新增5國共6件,分別為馬拉威2件、阿爾及利亞/查德/納米比亞/英國各1件。
NST5qw4KSTLm8LGw8R6uiA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 22 and 28 January, WPV1 had one new case in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2 had one new case each in the Central African Republic, Chad and Mali. For environmental samples, WPV1 had 9 new positive samples in Pakistan and 5 in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 had 6 new samples across 5 countries: 2 in Malawi, and 1 each in Algeria, Chad, Namibia and the United Kingdom.

dSjEaxSkzroRgkZ0V0v8Ew.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/14-20期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2例;cVDPV1新增剛果民主共和國1例;cVDPV2新增3國共28例,分別為葉門26例、安哥拉/中非共和國各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦42件,cVDPV2新增坦尚亞1件。
dSjEaxSkzroRgkZ0V0v8Ew.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 14–20 August, WPV1 increased by two cases in Pakistan, and circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1 (cVDPV1) increased by one case in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. cVDPV2 increased by 28 cases in three countries: Yemen (26), and Angola and the Central African Republic (1 each). For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 42 samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 by one sample in Tanzania.

kY4peGDHORIBotL0ZEMU2w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/1-5/7期間, cVDPV2型新增查德1例,cVDPV3新增幾內亞1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增阿富汗7件,cVDPV2陽性樣本新增3國共3件,分別為喀麥隆、中非共和國、吉布地各1件。
kY4peGDHORIBotL0ZEMU2w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 1 April and 7 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 1 in Chad, and cVDPV3 cases by 1 in Guinea. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 7 in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 3 across 3 countries: 1 each in Cameroon, the Central African Republic and Djibouti.

AdEEOhlIAriIvuJj5XJKmw.zh: 非洲疫情更新,2024年截至11/30累計1,138例病例,其中41例確診,7例死亡,病例分布於剛果 (452例)、中非共和國(390例)、加彭(146例)、南蘇丹(139例)、喀麥隆(8例)、幾內亞(2例)及烏干達(1例)。
AdEEOhlIAriIvuJj5XJKmw.en: Africa epidemic update: As of 30 November 2024, 1,138 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 41 confirmed and 7 deaths. Cases were distributed as follows: Republic of the Congo (452), Central African Republic (390), Gabon (146), South Sudan (139), Cameroon (8), Guinea (2) and Uganda (1).

xEwUk8l5_SOnMIeF9R0L9w.zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至10/17累計4國報告7,086例病例,其中1,469例確診,492例死亡(CFR:6.94%);流行國家中,以奈及利亞報告3,302例最為嚴峻,另有日報告2,781例、馬利707例及中非共和國296例。
xEwUk8l5_SOnMIeF9R0L9w.en: Africa epidemic update: As of 17 October this year, four countries had reported 7,086 cases cumulatively, including 1,469 confirmed and 492 deaths (CFR 6.94%). Among the affected countries, Nigeria reported the most, with 3,302 cases; Niger reported 2,781, Mali 707 and the Central African Republic 296.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.
